FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Trendy Threads Boutique operates as a retail and wholesale clothing store, specializing in fashionable apparel and accessories for men, women, and children. Our operations primarily involve purchasing high-quality clothing directly from manufacturers and wholesalers, which we then sell through our trendy physical store located in an upscale shopping district. We manage our inventory value to remain below $500,000 to mitigate the risk of theft and loss claims. The business strategy includes a balanced approach to sales, with online sales constituting less than 75% of our total revenue, thereby minimizing our exposure to cyber and fulfillment risks. We are committed to maintaining top-notch customer service, and our knowledgeable staff assists customers in finding styles that suit their needs. Additionally, we ensure compliance with all relevant regulations and safety standards to provide a secure shopping experience for our clients.

Our clothing and apparel store regularly maintains an inventory value exceeding $500,000 to offer a wide range of products to our customers, ensuring they have access to the latest styles and trends.

FIELDS.G1: Do/have past, present or discontinue: No – Trendy Threads Boutique does not engage in storing, treating, discharging, applying, disposing, or transporting hazardous materials as part of its retail operations. The business focuses on selling fashionable apparel and accessories without involvement in any hazardous materials activities.
FIELDS.G2: Are athletic teams sponsored?: No – Trendy Threads Boutique does not sponsor any athletic teams. The focus of the business is on retailing fashionable apparel and accessories, rather than engaging in sponsorship activities.
FIELDS.G3: Are sub-contractors allowed to work: No – Sub-contractors are not allowed to work without providing a certificate of insurance. The business requires verification of certificates to ensure proper risk transfer and compliance.
FIELDS.G4: Has any applicant been indicted or c: No – Trendy Threads Boutique has not had any applicants indicted or convicted of fraud, bribery, arson, or related crimes in connection with this property or any other property. The business maintains a focus on compliance and ethical operations.
FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – Trendy Threads Boutique has not had any policy or coverage declined, canceled, or non-renewed during the prior 3 years. The business maintains a strong compliance record with its insurance requirements.
FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – Trendy Threads Boutique does not lease employees to or from other employers. The business maintains its own staff to provide customer service and manage operations.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: No – Trendy Threads Boutique does not currently carry any Workers' Compensation insurance, as the business is structured to maintain compliance with regulations and minimize risks.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: No – Trendy Threads Boutique does not own or operate any other business, as it maintains focus solely on its core retail operations with inventory managed below compliance thresholds.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – Trendy Threads Boutique does not have any other insurance with this company, as the focus is solely on the current policy for retail operations. The business maintains its compliance with insurance requirements without additional coverage.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – Trendy Threads Boutique is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products. The business exclusively focuses on retailing high-quality clothing sourced from manufacturers and wholesalers.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – Trendy Threads Boutique does not rent or loan equipment to others. The business focuses solely on retailing clothing and accessories without engaging in equipment rental operations.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – Trendy Threads Boutique has not had any foreclosures, repossessions, bankruptcies, judgments, or liens in the past five years. The business maintains a strong financial standing and compliance with insurance requirements.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – Trendy Threads Boutique does not have any exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals, as the business solely focuses on retailing clothing and accessories without engaging in hazardous materials.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – The business maintains its inventory value at or below $500,000, which limits catastrophe exposure. Additionally, there is no central alarm system installed, impacting risk management.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – Trendy Threads Boutique has no past losses or claims relating to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. The business maintains a strong commitment to compliance and ethical practices in its operations.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – Trendy Threads Boutique has no uncorrected fire code violations. The business is committed to compliance with all relevant regulations to ensure a safe shopping environment.
